_about: Public-domain Richard Hooker (c.1554-1600, Anglican divine, Master of the Temple) for the Word Hoard: A Learned Discourse of Justification clean from CCEL, and the Works in John Keble's edition (Oxford: University Press, 1836, 3 vols, with Walton's Life), including Of the Laws of Ecclesiastical Polity, as raw Internet Archive OCR from Claremont and Toronto scans. CCEL's three 'Church Defended' volumes are stubs and are left off. Added 2026-10-02 by lane A, round 8 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
